title: 🏥 Multiple Healthcare Openings in DeSoto County, MS - $2K+/week Travel RN Roles - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Healthcare hiring is strong across DeSoto County right now, with new openings for nurses, therapists, and dietitians. Whether you want to stay local or take a travel contract, there’s something here for every healthcare pro.
Nurse RN Employer: Diversicare Healthcare Services, LLC
Location: Southaven, MS
Type: Full-time
Join a supportive team that values growth and offers career advancement from Charge Nurse to Director of Nursing. Great benefits and daily pay access included.
RN Nursing Supervisor Employer: Diversicare Healthcare Services, LLC
Location: Southaven, MS
Type: Full-time
Lead a team of nurses and shape patient care quality. Offers leadership training, mentorship, and a full benefits package.
Travel Cardiovascular OR Registered Nurse – $2,998/week Employer: Wellspring Nurse Source
Location: Southaven, MS
Type: Travel
12-week CVOR contract with strong weekly pay and full recruiter support from a nurse-owned agency.
Travel Emergency Room Registered Nurse – $2,252/week Employer: LeaderStat
Location: Olive Branch, MS
Type: Travel
13-week ER contract with night shifts and weekly pay. Includes 401(k), medical, and referral bonuses.
Travel Emergency Room Registered Nurse – $2,150/week Employer: Zack Group
Location: Olive Branch, MS
Type: Travel
Competitive pay, day-one health benefits, and housing stipends. Ideal for RNs with 2+ years of ER experience.
Travel Emergency Room Registered Nurse – $2,092/week Employer: GHR Healthcare
Location: Olive Branch, MS
Type: Travel
Trusted travel agency with 30+ years in healthcare staffing. Offers transparent pay and dedicated recruiter support.
Rehab Director Employer: TMC: Therapy Management Corporation
Location: Horn Lake, MS
Type: Full-time
Lead a therapy team across PT, OT, and speech services. Offers PTO, holidays, tuition reimbursement, and leadership growth.
Technologist – Medical Employer: Baptist Memorial Health Care
Location: Southaven, MS
Type: Full-time
Perform lab testing and quality control in a respected hospital setting. Requires a degree in Medical Laboratory Science.
Physical Therapist – Travel Contract Employer: Jackson Therapy Partners
Location: Southaven, MS
Type: Contract
Travel PT role in a skilled nursing facility. Weekly pay, housing, and 401(k) match from day one.
Registered Dietitian – Pediatrics Employer: Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare
Location: Hernando, MS
Type: Full-time
Provide pediatric nutrition therapy and education at Le Bonheur Children’s Hospital. Requires RD/N license.
Emergency Department Tech – FT Mid-Evening Employer: Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare
Location: Hernando, MS
Type: Full-time
Support nurses and physicians in the ER. Great entry point for EMTs looking to grow in hospital care.
If you’re ready to make a move, now’s a great time to apply. These roles are filling fast—check the links and find your next step in DeSoto County healthcare!
